选择表达式模式和时区，输入表达式或使用快捷模板，再计算未来 5 次执行时间。搜索: Choose a mode and time zone, enter an expression or use a preset, then calculate the next 5 runs within the next 5 years.
选择转换方向、单位和时区。日期使用 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss 格式: Choose the direction, unit, and time zone. Use YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss for dates. Results include ISO 8601 and timestamps in seconds and milliseconds.
粘贴内容或加载示例，选择选项并执行。结果支持复制或下载；错误时请根据提示修正输入: Paste content or load an example, choose your options, and run. Copy or download the result; follow any error messages to correct the input.
不会自动保存到服务器、浏览器存储或 URL。刷新页面会清除输入。只有当你主动选择: Input is not automatically saved to a server, browser storage, or the URL. Refreshing clears it. “Send to canvas” temporarily stores the result in this tab's sessionStorage and deletes it as soon as the canvas reads it. Downloaded files stay on your device. Optional analytics record pages and actions, never input, output, or raw errors.
单次输入限制为 5 MiB；JSON 最多嵌套 128 层、格式化结果最多约 2: Input is limited to 5 MiB. JSON supports up to 128 nesting levels and about 20 million formatted characters. Processing stops after 8 seconds; split large inputs and try again.

在画布上直接输入代码、修改标题。可自定义渐变背景、窗口样式、画布比例、起始行号和: Edit code and titles directly on the canvas. Customize gradients, window styles, aspect ratios, starting line numbers, and highlighted lines. Unsupported glyphs use system fallback fonts.
所有内容在浏览器内处理，不执行或上传代码。仅记住外观设置，不保存代码或标题。最多: All content is processed in your browser. Code is never executed or uploaded. Only appearance preferences are saved, not code or titles. Supports up to 12,000 characters, 160 lines, and 16 million export pixels. Set a fixed width in Appearance to wrap long lines.

适合代码、配置、SQL、日志和普通文本；单侧最多 1,200 行。: For code, configuration, SQL, logs, and plain text. Up to 1,200 lines per side.

按行处理的操作会保留文本顺序语义；大小写转换作用于全文。: Line operations work on individual lines; case conversion applies to the entire text.
生成常用计划，查看字段含义和未来执行时间。: Build schedules and inspect fields and upcoming run times.
